name: Mirador Cóndor over Lago Pehoé
region: Torres del Paine National Park, centre
why: A short, steep climb to the whole Paine massif over Lago Pehoé's turquoise; condors ride the wind at the top.
book: Park entry online. Starts by Camping Pehoé.
dangers: Steep and loose; very windy on top.

points.name: Camping Pehoé
points.note: By the lake shore, at the camp entrance.

points.name: Mirador Cóndor
points.note: The massif across Lago Pehoé, the hotel island below.
